<!--
Title convention (Conventional Commits): <type>(<scope>): <summary>
e.g. feat(auth): add password strength meter
-->

## What & why
<!-- What does this change do, and why is it needed? -->

## Type of change
- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] chore / ci / docs / test / security

## How was it tested?
<!-- Commands run, scenarios covered, screenshots for UI. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch named `<type>/<short-description>` off latest `main`
- [ ] Backend: `mvn test` passes (JDK 21)
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real IPs committed
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behavior or config changed
